analyst.summary: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys is a fully integrated ferrochrome producer with its own captive chrome-ore mines and power plants - a real structural cost advantage in a commodity business. The company's quant score points to Sell mainly because of weak growth over the last three years, but that period captured an industry-wide down-cycle, not company-specific decline - the current trend is a clear recovery, with quarterly margins nearly doubling year-on-year and full-year profit up over 12%. The balance sheet is healthy and a capacity-expansion plan is underway. We think the recent recovery and clean finances argue for holding rather than selling, though this remains a cyclical commodity business whose growth should not be overstated.
